note: AUDIO-9: a card's Stop names its cue and clears a slot only if that cue still holds it; the strip's Stop is Stop all (cue_id null). A Stop carries no epoch and is never queued (X-3).

invalid.name: a Stop with an epoch
invalid.why: X-3, AUDIO-28: a Stop is never stale, so it carries no epoch; a request is strict

invalid.name: no cue key
invalid.why: Stop all is an explicit null, never a missing key

invalid.name: a slot instead of a cue
invalid.why: a Stop names a cue, so one queued in one tab cannot silence a newer cue from another (AUDIO-9)
